name: Long live the empress: Yeohwangui Chimsil
original_name: Long live the empress : 여황의 침실
source:
The Curse of the Dead befalls the Heath Empire. You, the Empress, are told that sleeping with your consort is the only way to break this curse. But instead of bedding the betrothed your family chose for you, you decide to bring in a beautiful slave as your lover... Who will you choose in the midst of the chaos the curse and its political battles bring?

[From in-app]
translation:
亡者的詛咒降臨希斯帝國。身為女皇的你被告知，只有與配偶同床共枕，才能解除詛咒。然而，你沒有選擇與家族指定的婚約對象共寢，反而決定納一名美麗的奴隸作為戀人……在詛咒與政治鬥爭帶來的混亂之中，你會選擇誰？

[摘自App內的]
